exposure: Length of stay at the SCBU
outcome: Proportion of live preterm neonates who were discharged after SCBU admissions
cohort: 2,254 preterm babies admitted to the Special Care Baby Unit (SCBU) at the Cape Coast Teaching Hospital (CCTH) from 2010 to 2019
finding: Factors which influenced survival were birth weight, gestational age, mode and place of delivery, APGAR scores at 1st and 5th minutes, and length of stay at the SCBU.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery (vaginal vs. cesarean section) was found to influence survival of preterm infants.
